mapper.sql: r.id, r.name, r.category_code, c.name AS category_name, r.price_per_person, r.price_kind, r.address, r.latitude, r.longitude, r.coordinate_system, r.needs_location, r.business_status, r.source_type, r.created_at, r.updated_at, CASE WHEN r.needs_location = 0 AND r.latitude IS NOT NULL AND r.longitude IS NOT NULL THEN 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(0.0, POWER(SIN(RADIANS(r.latitude - 30.7544) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(30.7544)) * COS(RADIANS(r.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(r.longitude - 103.9312) / 2), 2))))) ELSE NULL END AS distance_km

WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.category_code = #{query.category} AND r.business_status = 'OPERATING' AND 1 = 0
AND (r.name LIKE #{query.keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!' OR r.address LIKE #{query.keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!' OR c.name LIKE #{query.keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM restaurant_tags t WHERE t.restaurant_id = r.id AND t.tag LIKE #{query.keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!'))
mapper.select: SELECT code, name, sort_order, enabled FROM restaurant_categories ORDER BY sort_order, code
SELECT FROM restaurants r JOIN restaurant_categories c ON c.code = r.category_code WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM restaurants r JOIN restaurant_categories c ON c.code = r.category_code

SELECT FROM restaurants r JOIN restaurant_categories c ON c.code = r.category_code
ORDER BY
r.price_per_person IS NULL, r.price_per_person, distance_km IS NULL, distance_km,
r.name, r.id LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT t.restaurant_id, t.tag, t.position FROM restaurant_tags t JOIN restaurants r ON r.id = t.restaurant_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.restaurant_id IN #{id} ORDER BY t.restaurant_id, t.position
